name: English
note: Translation of the German source. "text" is filled in by "npm run locale:sync" and translated by hand; an entry equal to the German one means untranslated, and the player sees German there.

keys.ui.language_next: It appears on the next screen change.
keys.ui.language_now: It is available to you here and now.
keys.ui.language_timing: New captions are created in the chosen language. {mode}
keys.ui.no_languages: No language catalogue found — the game stays in German.
keys.ui.queue_full: Queue full (at most %d) — the oldest suggestion was dropped: “%s”

ui.queue_waiting.one: {count} suggestion is waiting for the network
ui.queue_waiting.other: {count} suggestions are waiting for the network

keys.ui.report_copied: Copied to the clipboard — just paste it in your mail app.
keys.ui.report_no_mail_app: No mail app opened — the text is in the clipboard now.
keys.ui.report_unconfigured: No report address configured yet (MODERATION_MAIL in app_legal.gd).
keys.ui.server_hint: Without an address the game runs on the bundled content, and suggestions stay local until you enter one here.
keys.ui.suggest_cluster: Similar suggestions already exist (a cluster of %d entries) — your vote counts there too.
keys.ui.suggest_hint: New content, mechanics, balance or bugs — everything is collected on the dashboard and prioritised there. What gets built shows up in the game directly.
keys.ui.suggest_placeholder: e.g. Add an enemy that splits into two smaller slimes when it dies …
keys.ui.suggest_queued: Saved, but not sent to the server yet. The idea goes out as soon as you are online again.
keys.ui.suggest_thanks: Thank you! Your suggestion is in as #%d.%s
keys.ui.suggest_too_short: Please write at least a few words.
keys.ui.ticker_empty: Nothing built yet — send in the first suggestion!
keys.ui.ticker_nothing_to_report: No suggestion is running — nothing to report.

text.3D-Merge-Brett im Weihnachtsstil: Kombin: A 3D merge board in Christmas style: combine 3 or 5 matching items into finer decorations.
text.Ab Level %d kündigt sich der Nachschub a: From level %d on, reinforcements announce themselves; the card names the side.
text.Action-RPG in der Drachenruine: Erlege D: An action RPG in the dragon ruin: fight off waves of dragons, gather gold and loot, and upgrade your weapon and level.
Every breed is in the stable.
All rival castles belong to you.
text.Alle vorgemerkten Meshes kommen in einen: Every shortlisted mesh goes into a single suggestion. The text below is already filled in — change only what you want differently.
text.Arena-Survival: Überlebe Wellen, sammle: Arena survival: survive the waves, collect XP and upgrade your weapon.
text.Aufbauspiel nach Die Siedler: Fahnen und: A settlers-style building game: banners and carriers move your goods, tools and mines go hungry.
Balanced, one shot at a time.
text.Backt Mehl zu Brot. Ohne Brot stehen die: Bakes flour into bread. Without bread the mines grind to a halt.
text.Baue ein U-Bahn-Netz in einer 3D-Stadt:: Build a subway network in a 3D city: draw lines, place trains, survive rush hour.
text.Baue ein U-Bahn-Netz, das eine wachsende: Build a subway network that keeps a growing city alive.
text.Baut Korn an — Ausgangspunkt der gesamte: Grows grain — the starting point of the entire food chain.
text.Bisher verschmolzen: %d× · Aktive Boni: Merged so far: %d×  ·  Active bonuses: +%d%% speed · +%d%% jump · %d bonus jumps
Cuts building stone out of the quarry.
text.Crystal-Jumper-Halloweenlevel: Sammle na: Crystal Jumper Halloween level: collect pumpkins at night and merge them into ghosts.
text.Crystal-Jumper-Weihnachtslevel: Sammle G: Crystal Jumper Christmas level: collect baubles in the snow and reach the summit.
text.Dafür fehlt der Burg das Baumaterial: The castle is short of building material for that
Thank you! Suggestion #%d is on the dashboard.
text.Das Sucht-Puzzle: Verschiebe die Kacheln: The addictive puzzle: slide the tiles, merge matching numbers and build the 2048 tile.
Your rivals have taken your castle.
text.Der Brett-Klassiker: Ziehe diagonal, sch: The board classic: move diagonally, capture the AI’s pieces and crown your king.
text.Der Endstand der Zucht. Riesig, schnell,: The end of the breeding line. Huge, fast, hungry.
text.Der Klassiker: Stapel Tetrominos, räume: The classic: stack tetrominoes, clear lines and survive the ever-faster drops.
text.Dieselben 3er-/5er-Merges als Halloween-: The same 3- and 5-merges as a Halloween edition — merge pumpkins into ghost pumpkins.
text.Dir ist etwas eingefallen? Reiche es ein: Just thought of something? Submit it — maybe it is in the game next time.
text.Drei Schüsse gleichzeitig in engem Fäche: Three shots at once in a tight spread.
text.Ein Ei liegt im Nest: One egg is in the nest
text.Ein Panzer in der Luft. Langsam, trifft: A tank in the sky. Slow, but hits hard.
text.Ein Spiel, das von seinen Spielern gebau: A game built by its own players.
text.Erhöht die Siedler-Obergrenze um 6 und r: Raises the settler cap by 6 and clears 200 storage slots in the castle. Without storage the pantry fills up eventually, and a full castle stops accepting deliveries.
text.Erweitert das Territorium, solange minde: Expands your territory as long as at least 1 knight is garrisoned.
text.Fahne dort antippen, wo das Quadrat blin: Tap a banner where the square flashes
text.Fahne gesetzt — mehr Träger auf dieser S: Banner placed — more carriers on this road
text.Fällt Bäume und liefert Baumstämme. Brau: Fells trees and delivers logs. Needs an axe from the toolshop.
text.Fertigt Schwert und Schild. Damit rüstes: Forges swords and shields. Use them to equip knights for the watchtower.
text.Fischt auf offenen Wasser. Braucht eine: Fishes on open water. Needs a fishing rod.
text.Fliege mit deinem Drachen über 30 Level,: Fly your dragon through 30 levels, breed offspring with inherited traits and collect dragon gold.
text.Fördert Eisenerz. Braucht Spitzhacke und: Mines iron ore. Needs a pickaxe and food.
Mines gold ore for the goldsmith.
text.Fördert Kohle. Braucht Spitzhacke und Na: Mines coal. Needs a pickaxe and food for the miner.
text.Fröhliches Klettern! Sammle Weihnachtssc: Happy climbing! Collect Christmas decorations and reach the summit.
text.Gelände zu steil — Planierer nötig: Ground too steep — a bulldozer is needed
text.Gemütlicher Modus: schwächere und langsa: Cosy mode: weaker and slower enemies, fewer spawns.
text.Geschoss teilt sich und sammelt Gold aus: The projectile splits and hoovers up gold from the air.
text.Gezählt wird jeder Umschlag seit dem let: Every trip since the last road is counted. The map measures, the optimiser decides.
Halts all balls for six seconds.
text.Hauptquartier. Hier lagern Bauholz, Eise: Headquarters. Planks, iron and the tools are stored here — and settlers are trained here for free jobs.
text.Höchste Trefferchance, sieht im Zwiel Li: Highest hit chance, almost invisible in twilight light.
text.Jeder Abschuss bringt Gold. Die Wirtscha: Every dive brings gold. The economy of flight.
text.Karte antippen = wählen · Bestätigen: Tap a card to select   ·   Confirm = strongest offer
text.Karten-Solitaire mit vier freien Zellen:: Card solitaire with four free cells: sort all 52 cards into the foundations.
text.Kein Merge möglich — kurz warten: No merge possible — wait a moment
text.Keine Eier im Nest. Fliege level und sam: No eggs in the nest. Fly a level and collect some.
text.Klassiker im 3D-Diorama: Spieß alle Kuge: The classic in a 3D diorama: skewer every ball before time runs out — 30 levels and four bonuses.
text.Klettere den Turm, sammle Kristalle und: Climb the tower, collect crystals and merge them into jewels at the summit.
text.Knapp vorbei an einem Block zahlt Punkte: Missing a block by a hair scores points and builds the chain
text.Langsamer, aber zäh — hält Treffer gut a: Slower but tough — soaks up hits well.
text.Leertaste: kurzer Dash mit Unverwundbark: Space bar: a short dash with invulnerability (1.5s cooldown).
text.Mahlt Korn zu Mehl. Dreht sich nur, wenn: Grinds grain into flour. Only turns when it is fed grain.
text.Match-3 in 6 Welten mit 240 Leveln: Bonb: Match-3 across 6 worlds with 240 levels: swap candies, trigger chains and clear blocks.
text.Mehr Spiele folgen — reiche deine Idee e: More games to come — send in your idea!  ·  Content v%d
text.Noch kein Verkehr gemessen. Baue eine St: No traffic measured yet. Build a road from the castle to a producer and let the carriers run.
text.Offline gespeichert — der Vorschlag geht: Saved offline — the suggestion goes out as soon as you are online again.
text.Pflanzt nach, was der Holzfäller gefällt: Replants what the woodcutter felled. Without a forester the forest runs out eventually — and without wood the whole settlement grinds to a halt.
text.Poker gegen drei Computer-Gegner: Setze,: Poker against three computer opponents: bet, raise, bluff and win the pot.
text.Reißt Wolken auf: schnellste Wendigkeit: Tears the clouds apart: the fastest agility in the game.
text.Reite mit dem Pferd über den Erdweg, spr: Ride your horse along the dirt track, jump logs, rocks and fences and dodge the trees.
text.Robuster Starter. Feuert schnell und ver: A sturdy starter. Fires fast and forgives mistakes.
text.Rosen, Tulpen und Seerosen im Wind: Roses, tulips and water lilies in the wind
text.Sammle Kürbisse bei Nacht und klettere z: Collect pumpkins at night and climb to the ghost summit.
text.Schmiedet aus 1 Eisen + 1 Holz beliebige: Forges any tool from 1 iron + 1 wood. You control the order yourself with the tool buttons!
text.Schmilzt Eisenerz mit Kohle zu Eisen — d: Smelts iron ore with coal into iron — the foundation of every toolshop.
text.Schmilzt Golderz mit Kohle zu Goldbarren: Smelts gold ore with coal into ingots. Gold raises your knights’ morale in the attack.
text.Spieß alle Kugeln auf, bevor die Zeit ab: Skewer every ball before time runs out.
text.Start und Ziel sind identisch: Start and target are the same
text.Startfeld gewählt — jetzt das Ziel antip: Start tile chosen — now tap the target
text.Startfeld: die Burg — jetzt das Ziel ant: Start tile: the castle — now tap the target
text.Station antippen und verketten · erste: Tap stations to chain them  ·  tapping the first station again closes a loop
text.Stein antippen, dann Zielfeld wählen ·: Tap a stone, then choose a target square  ·  captures are marked  ·  ♛ is crowned
text.Stick / WASD bewegen · Zielen mit Fing: Stick / WASD to move  ·  Aim with finger or mouse  ·  Auto-fire  ·  Dash  ·  ESC pause
text.Stick bewegen · ⚔ Angriff (auch Auto-Zie: Move the stick · ⚔ Attack (also auto-aim) · » Dragon escape (short invulnerability)
text.Stick bewegen · Sprung-Taste · Gipfel er: Move the stick · jump button · reach the summit!
text.Stick oder ◀ ▶ laufen · ⇈ Haken · ‖ Paus: Stick or ◀ ▶ to run · ⇈ hook · ‖ pause
text.Stick oder ◀ ▶ zum Spurwechsel · ▲ sprin: Stick or ◀ ▶ to switch lane · ▲ jump
text.Tipp: erst Schlosserei, dann Minen — ohn: Hint: toolshop first, then mines — without iron there are no tools.
text.Tippe einen Sockel an, um ihn als Eltern: Tap a pedestal to pick it as a parent
Hits poison the enemy over time.
text.Vier Projektile mit Streuung, kurze Reic: Four projectiles in a spread, short range.
text.Wandelt Baumstämme in Bauholz. Jedes Geb: Turns logs into planks. Every building costs planks.
text.Was bremst deine Siedlung?: What is holding your settlement back?
text.Wendig wie der Wind — der beste Allround: As agile as the wind — the best all-rounder.

text.zieht beim nächsten Zug mit und wird dan: hatches with the next brood and is then final
text.Zuckerstangen, Glaskugeln und Stollenste: Candy canes, baubles and gingerbread stars
